title: Continue Statement
concept: continue skips the rest of the current loop iteration and jumps to the next one.
why: Sometimes you want to skip certain values in a loop — like processing only even numbers or ignoring invalid data.
tips: `continue` skips to the NEXT iteration, not out of the loop
Use `continue` to filter out values you don't want to process
Make sure your counter still increments before `continue`
common_mistakes: Incrementing after `continue` — the increment is skipped too! Always update before `continue`
Confusing `continue` with `break` — continue keeps looping, break stops
Using `continue` when an `if/else` would be clearer
